description: Source code for the tmag5170 magnetic sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including register definitions, communication functions, data conversion, and device initialization.

methods.name: tmag5170_transmit_raw
methods.description: Performs raw SPI transceive with the sensor using provided buffers.

methods.name: tmag5170_transmit
methods.description: Transmits data with optional CRC check.

methods.name: tmag5170_write_register
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit value to a specified register.

methods.name: tmag5170_read_register
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit value from a specified register.

methods.name: tmag5170_convert_magn_reading_to_gauss
methods.description: Converts raw magnetometer reading to Gauss units.

methods.name: tmag5170_convert_temp_reading_to_celsius
methods.description: Converts raw temperature reading to Celsius.

methods.name: tmag5170_covert_angle_reading_to_degrees
methods.description: Converts raw angle reading to degrees.

methods.name: tmag5170_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches sensor data for specified channel.

methods.name: tmag5170_channel_get
methods.description: Gets sensor data in human-readable form for specified channel.

methods.name: tmag5170_pm_action
methods.description: Handles power management actions for the device.
